description: §15.10.1 (S458 F1) — a prop referenced inside an attribute expression is replaced by the caller's EXPRESSION as a tree: precedence is kept (`n * 2` with `n=${@a + 1}` is 8, not 5 — unquoted and inside a quoted `"v=${n*2}"`); one simultaneous pass, so a caller expression is never re-scanned (`href=${"/x/" + label}` keeps the row alias `label`, not the component's `label` prop); and string-literal content is never rewritten (`' label'`, `'visible'`).
rationale: §15.10.1: 'The compiler SHALL replace every identifier reference that matches a declared prop name with the caller-side value at expansion time' — an identifier REFERENCE (not text inside a string literal), replaced by the caller-side value (an expression, whose grouping is its own).
